name: Dialog
description:
Props for {@link Dialog}.

Extends the native `<div>` attributes so DOM props (`id`, `data-*`, `aria-*`, `onKeyDown`,
…) pass through onto the panel element. The native `title` attribute (a `string`) is
`Omit`-ted first so the Lyra `title` can be redefined as `ReactNode` — without the `Omit`
the interface fails strict typecheck (native `HTMLAttributes.title` is a string attribute).
signature: export declare function Dialog(props: DialogProps): JSX.Element;

props.name: open
props.description: Controls visibility. `true` mounts the overlay + panel; `false` plays the exit then unmounts.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Called by every close path (Esc, overlay click, the × button). The × renders only when this is provided.

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: Accessible name for the close button. Default: `"Close"`.

props.name: title
props.description: Heading rendered in the panel header and wired as the accessible name via `aria-labelledby`.

props.name: footer
props.description: Action buttons rendered in the footer. Omitted → no `.lyra-dialog__footer` chrome.

props.name: closeOnEsc
props.description: Close on the Escape key. Default `true`.

props.name: closeOnOverlayClick
props.description: Close on a click on the overlay backdrop (never on panel content). Default `true`.

props.name: container
props.description: Portal host. Defaults to `document.body`.

props.name: children
props.description: Body content.

name: Input
description:
Props for {@link Input}.

Extends the native `<input>` attributes so every DOM prop (`type`, `placeholder`,
`value`, `defaultValue`, `onChange`, `disabled`, `aria-*`, …) passes straight through
onto the `<input>` element. The native numeric `size` attribute is `Omit`-ted first so
the Lyra control-height `size` (`'sm' | 'md' | 'lg'`) can be redefined without colliding
with the native `size?: number` under strict TypeScript.

props.description: Error message — enables the error styling (`.lyra-input--error` + `.lyra-hint--error`), sets `aria-invalid`, and replaces `hint`.

props.description: Control height. Default `"md"` (sm 32px · md 40px · lg 48px).

props.name: iconLeft
props.description: Icon rendered inside the field, on the left (e.g. `<Icon name="search" size={16} />`).
